name: dev-loop
description: Marketplace for dev-loop — a wiki-grounded implementation loop plugin for Claude Code (loop-orchestrator + dev-llm-wiki, merged).

plugins.name: dev-loop
plugins.description: Multi-agent orchestration grounded in an LLM wiki. /dev-loop:orchestrate splits one goal into a dependency graph of parallel Claude Code sessions, each in its own worktree, and supervises them natively on Orca (a tracked Task + Dispatch per phase, pushed worker_done / question / escalation events instead of polling, stall detection; raw tmux fallback). Every plan decision must cite a page in a bundled best-practice wiki of 400+ pages across 10 domains, checked by machine gates and a fresh-context plan reviewer, and verified insights from your sessions return as reviewed wiki PRs.
